blurb: Realco Guns offers a full line of guns and shooting accessories tailored for marksmen, hunters, collectors, and self-defense. They provide a weekly Handgun Qualification License (HQL) training session and advanced concealed carry training. They also offer gunsmithing, firearm inheritance assistance, appraisals, and nationwide brokerage services.
